column1: # Games to keep off /library even though a source still lists them.
# One entry per line: a BGG id, or a title when the game has no BGG id.
# Anything after a second tab is a note for humans. Blank lines and lines
# This file exists because src/data/bgg/*.tsv is re-harvested wholesale from
# BoardGameGeek — deleting a row there is undone the next time a collection is
# refreshed. Exclusions have to live outside the harvest to survive it.
# Excluding by BGG id removes the game entirely, including copies contributed
# by other collections. To drop only one collection's copy — the owner is not
# bringing theirs, but somebody else still is — scope the id to that
# collection with `<bggId>@<collection>`, where the collection is the name of
# its file in src/data/bgg/ without the .tsv. The game keeps its card and
# loses a copy. A collection that does not exist is an error, not a no-op.
